recap.text: Zhang and Li Jun stand on a stage before the Maestro. Li Na and the manager are boxed in by hatching Brindled Vespas and troglodytes. Zhang says to put the two teleport points on Li Jun and Li Na. A barefoot man starts whispering and the arithmetic changes.

Li Jun tells Zhang about Carl, so Zhang runs from the safe room. Zhang uses the last charge of a shrinking wand on a train to save the group, which kills everyone on board and lets Zhang jump six levels. Zhang is an Earth Mover who uses a spell called Dirt Clod and wears black and gold armor that glows in the dark.

Zhang, Li Jun, and Bautista freeze while Li Na does not. The AI opens a boss battle against six naga and a level 250 god, placing a 2X Jackpot on Zhang living. Zhang finds a cape with his name on it that gives fifteen per cent on everything and one spin per hour with three hundred and thirty-three outcomes. Zhang and Li Na mourn Li Jun.

Na kills five teams in the heat, leaving Tran and two NPC teams as replacements. Zhang and Na win again, leaving only crawler teams, including a fire truck driven by Sammi Harrison, the decapitator. Zhang proposes killing their own mount to remove Na and himself from the race, but Carl says Na could still reach the finish. Zhang presses a button to put Na in a pet carrier, which a white bot takes away.

beats.headline: Two teleport points, four people
beats.text: Li Jun and I are standing on a stage in front of the Maestro while he plays with us, and behind us Li Na and the manager are boxed in between hatching Brindled Vespas and troglodytes with nowhere to go. We have two teleport points. Two. I say put them on Li Jun and Li Na and leave me where I am, because that is the arithmetic and somebody has to say it out loud. Then a barefoot man starts whispering, and the arithmetic changes.
beats.gist: Carl tells the Maestro to put two teleport points on Li Jun and Li Na.

beats.headline: The last charge of the wand
beats.text: Li Jun tells me what Carl is trying to do, so I run all the way from the safe room. The cart will not fit the hallway. I have a wand that shrinks things. It does not work on living things. We shrank a monster's collar once and it choked him. I used it on a train that was going to run us down; it killed everyone on board and I jumped six levels at once. One charge left, saved for an emergency. This is one. Five minutes small, and it is still as heavy as before.
beats.gist: Zhang runs from the safe room and uses the last charge of a shrinking wand.

beats.headline: Still human, and heavier for it
beats.text: I stayed human at selection. No fur, no beak, nothing added on. Earth Mover for the class, which is a spellcaster and a wall in the same body, and Dirt Clod is exactly what it sounds like and it works better than it has any right to. The armour I am in now is black and gold and glows in the dark.
beats.gist: Zhang stayed human at selection and chose the Earth Mover class to be a spellcaster and wall.

beats.headline: 2X Jackpot if Zhang Lives
beats.text: Frozen. So are Li Jun and Bautista. Li Na is not. Carl says run the moment we unfreeze. Then the AI opens a boss battle and a betting window, and says somebody has to die spectacularly, plus maybe that Zhang guy since nobody ever talks about him anymore. Hey. What the fuck? My portrait goes up beside Carl's, Katia's, Prepotente's, Li Jun's and Bautista's, with a flashing sign over it: 2X Jackpot if Zhang Lives. Across from us, six naga. And a god, level 250.
beats.gist: The AI offers a 2X Jackpot if Zhang lives during a boss battle against six naga.

beats.headline: Zhang's Cape of Odds
beats.text: A box opens and there is a cape in it with my own name written into the item. That happens to Carl. It does not happen to me. Zhang's Cape of Odds: fifteen per cent on everything, and once an hour a spin with three hundred and thirty-three outcomes, sixty-six of them bad. I will not spin it unless I have to. Carl has given Li Na his spare ring, and did not look happy about it. I have stopped being surprised by what the audience decides to give us and started asking what it is for.
beats.gist: Zhang receives a cape with his name on it that gives fifteen per cent on everything.

beats.headline: Proud to be her friend
beats.text: The cat asks the chat to make sure I am okay. I haven't said anything. Imani is with me. Jun was always afraid he would not do anything important. He was afraid his sister would be lost without him. Donut helped her get strong enough to protect herself. That would have made him proud. It makes me proud to have her as a friend. She says she's sorry. She has nothing to apologise for. He was my best friend, and I have nothing but admiration and respect for her.
beats.gist: Zhang is proud to be Imani's friend.

beats.headline: Tran's team in our heat
beats.text: Prepotente's theory holds, mostly. Na killed five of the other teams in our heat, so there are four replacements at the starting line. Two are NPC teams. Two are crawler teams, and one of those is Tran's. Na is sitting behind me and not reacting to any of it. I have the reins for this race. I do not know what to do. I put that in the chat the way it is, because there is no better way to say it.
beats.gist: Na kills five teams, so four replacements including Tran's team start the race.

beats.headline: Every team left is a crawler
beats.text: We won again. The teams still in our heat are all crawlers now. One is a fire truck driven by Sammi Harrison, an isopod summoner who was instrumental in keeping the FUPA safe in Faction Wars. Some people call her the decapitator. I think she and the others are conspiring against us. I tell Carl so, as a fact, because it is the thing in front of me.
beats.gist: Zhang notes the remaining teams in the heat are crawlers, including Sammi Harrison, a fire truck-driving isopod summoner.

beats.headline: He offers to go with her
beats.text: Li Na has gone somewhere none of us can reach, and everyone who rode with us in the last heat is dead. So I say it out loud in the Lollipop with everyone listening: next race, I kill our own mount. That takes her out of it. It takes me out of it too, and I have thought about that part, and it is still the cleanest thing I can see. Carl says it will not work any more: we only lose our containment, and she can reach the finish without a mount where I cannot. He says there has to be another way.
beats.gist: Zhang offers to go with Li Na.

beats.headline: He has to press the button
beats.text: The manager hands me the pet carrier, because it has to be me. I tell her I'm sorry it was Jun and not me, and that I hope he isn't angry I didn't watch over her like I promised. She opens her good eye and says I have nothing to apologise for. Then she nods. I point the carrier and press the button, and she's inside it. The white bot picks it up, and it's gone. Everyone looks at the cactus. No change. That is the result we want.
beats.gist: Zhang presses the button to put the manager in a pet carrier for a white bot.

relations.note: Same warehouse, same shift, same stairs.
Bullied for a segment on Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem.
